TENDER REFERENCE: T-2024-001              Page 1
TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS - SECTION 3
The equipment shall operate within -10 °C to 55 °C ambient temperature.
The equipment shall be protected to IP65 ingress protection.

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS - SECTION 3
The equipment shall have a stainless steel housing.
The maximum weight shall not exceed 25 kg.
